L’Acte européen sur l’accessibilité, dir: The European Accessibility Act, Directive (EU) 2019/882, has applied since 28 June 2025 to certain consumer products and services, including e-commerce. Its scope has exceptions, including microenterprises providing services. It does not impose a universal requirement on every PDF.
